name: Audio Reactive RGB Dispersion
description: RGB dispersion driven by the live 128-bin FFT: the spectral centroid steers direction and width, spectral spread turns two crisp fringes into a rainbow smear on broadband sound, and bass pushes a radial lens-like split while treble slides it sideways. Interior wavelength taps follow a Cauchy curve, and the falloff prefers local contrast along the dispersion axis. Blue also defocuses into the dark side of clipped highlights (longitudinal CA, purple fringing), the bass-driven radial split grows as r^3 like a real lens (corners fringe more than the centre), and the fringe is the same pixel size in every direction on non-square canvases. Passthrough grade, no filmic curve.
